primary_order_validation: Both final cohorts pass recorded-order validation. The earlier two-variant runs always ran baseline first because rotation and reversal canceled; those datasets are exploratory, not the primary comparison.
variant_names: In exploratory-guarded, v5 names PlaybackStateGuardedTrial.swift. In exploratory-batched and exploratory-controls, v5 names PlaybackStateBatched.swift. In exploratory-partition and final-* it names the delivered production file. The batched variant explicitly names PlaybackStateBatched.swift.
legacy_test_source_note: The first exploratory-guarded manifests reference an earlier assertion-only version of PlaybackStatePublicationTests.swift which was not archived byte-for-byte. Production and timed harness sources were retained. Its changes were to no-op catalogue assertions outside timed loops. The batched assertion version is retained in baseline/PlaybackStatePublicationChecksBatched.swift; final test/harness/production files match final manifests.
frameworks: Actual Swift Foundation and Observation, no GUI or image adapters in this pass. Static Swift runtime linkage on Linux resolves the supplied dynamic Observation library hidden-symbol linkage problem without replacing runtime functions.
not_run: macOS SDK/application build, full repository test graph, native Instruments or UI layout/rendering, physical footprint/energy. Earlier cache/persistence suites were not rerun in v5; their source and evidence are retained unchanged.
timing_runs: Every current-pass driver completed; no outlier removal. Warmup is 200 method calls, timed loops 400-20000 calls. Fresh processes on shared AMD EPYC 9V74 Linux host. Timing is synchronous call service time, not UI tail latency.
